fields.fld9r6n3YXyXDB7Sb: As a sought-after coach, mentor, speaker and author, Yu Dan writes personal development books combining engaging narratives with evidence-based research on positive psychology, optimal working habits, career strategy and science of happiness. After hitting rock bottom in 2008 while working as an executive for a Fortune 100 company, she was compelled to search for more meaningful ways to work and live. Today, Yu Dan helps other professionals, executives and entrepreneurs find joy and clarity in their work and live an inspired life. Yu Dan was born in Shanghai, China and has resided in Sydney, Australia since 1997.

Author, Productivity Expert, Speaker and Facilitator
fields.fld9r6n3YXyXDB7Sb:
Dermot Crowley is one of Australia's foremost thought-leaders on productivity. He is the author of Smart Work, and the founder of Adapt Training Solutions. Building on many years of experience in the productivity training industry, he started Adapt in 2002 with a vision of helping management and staff in Australia’s leading organisations to manage their time, priorities and emails more effectively using tools like MS Outlook and mobile technology.

Dermot has a highly inspiring yet practical approach to productivity in the modern workplace. His passion is creating real behavioural change, and has developed a system for working productively that is applicable to anyone working in today’s busy, email driven workplace.

While remaining heavily involved in the training activities of the business, much of Dermot's time is spent working with senior leaders and leadership teams on their productivity, and their ability to lead productivity in their teams. His pragmatic approach and wealth of experience ensure that he brings relevant strategies to the table for the leadership level. His focus on productivity technology ensures that executives are getting the most from the tools at their fingertips.

Chris Green is the Managing Director of GYB Regional and is a regional consultant who focuses on transforming and growing Entrepreneurial Businesses.

Chris is now expanding his services worldwide through his Business by Design Program. The program was created to give entrepreneurial businesses the support of himself and like-minded business owners who are at a similar stage of business.

Chris places great value on understanding his client’s goals and outcomes to deliver positive results.

Combining practical, commercial, and technical expertise. Chris has significant experience in creating impactful strategic and business development programs.
